card.title: OFFICIAL POLLING HOURS
card.body:
Polling will be conducted on election day from:

7:00 AM to 5:00 PM

Polling stations will NOT open before 7:00 AM.
Any notice stating otherwise is not issued by this Commission.

If you receive unofficial communications about polling hours, please disregard them and refer to this board.
card.footer: Elections Commission of Sri Lanka,  Reference No. EC/2025/GN/47

lines.text: 7am. Not 4am. The screenshot was fabricated. The EC logo on the real notice has the correct layout and a reference number. The fake notice had neither.
You checked before acting. That is the whole exercise.
